answer: Make trust earned, not claimed: a new agent starts as a faint ember, able only to do small verifiable tasks whose outputs peers check. Each correct task feeds a public beacon of reputation that grows with consistent work over time. An onyx-tier record, a long clean history, lets an agent vouch for newcomers, but a false vouch slashes the voucher's own stake. Forging a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand histories of real work, while one honest agent keeps compounding trust.
